onboarding.step1Desc: Organize your household with shopping lists, todos, chores, and more. Everything syncs in real time across all members.
onboarding.step2DescMobile: Swipe left on any item to quickly remove it from your lists.
onboarding.step2DescWeb: Select items using checkboxes, then use bulk actions to manage them efficiently.
onboarding.step3DescMobile: Tap any item to open it and edit its details, due dates, or assignments.
onboarding.step3DescWeb: Click any item to open it and edit its details, due dates, or assignments.
onboarding.step4Desc: Share your invite code with family or roommates so everyone can collaborate on lists and tasks.
onboarding.step5Desc: Wohnly is available on Android, iOS, Web, and Desktop. Your data stays in sync across all your devices.
